requirements.statement: Every result binds the exact C subject and source manifest.
The C dialect and supported compiler profile are exact and pinned.
Every supported C build is warning-clean under its pinned profile.
Integer, size, offset, count and allocation arithmetic are checked.
Public pointers and handles declare ownership, lifetime, mutability and release.
Chunk, coordinate and linear-index operations are total and bounds checked.
Authoritative simulation and RNG are fixed-step and deterministic.
Binary saves are bounded, versioned and migration aware.
Persistence uses typed atomic commit and recovery semantics.
Correctness has no undeclared dependency on undefined behavior.
Rendering, simulation and persistence have distinct authority boundaries.
Python is limited to authoring and verification for the live C runtime.
The C coding profile grants no network, install, deploy or authority-change effect.
